UserStory: As an owner seeking help, I want a clear warning before exporting household data so that I do not overshare.
AcceptanceCriteria: Both buttons require confirm acknowledging household data. | Snapshot still reminds to keep secrets key.
SuccessMetric: Support channels stop receiving raw snapshot zips (maintainer observation).

Title: Put Monday pass on the Admin landing path
UserStory: As an owner opening Admin on Monday, I want the pass in front of me without hunting Health.
AcceptanceCriteria: Overview presents Monday pass CTA or embedded hero. | Health remains the full ritual surface.
SuccessMetric: Share of Monday Admin sessions that reach Health ≥ 80%.

Title: Aggregate repeated log lines in Admin → Logs
UserStory: As an owner debugging Play failures, I want unique errors visible without fighting spam.
AcceptanceCriteria: Identical consecutive (or windowed) lines collapse with count. | Expanding a group shows timestamps.
SuccessMetric: Distinct fingerprints visible in first screenful during MAC mismatch incident.

Title: Publish household stack status when Live/LLM/Mail are off
UserStory: As a member, I want to know Live is intentionally off so that I do not ping the owner every evening.
AcceptanceCriteria: Members see non-alarmist status for Live Off / LLM unset / Mail off. | No Admin deep links required for members.
SuccessMetric: Owner-reported “is Live broken?” asks down after ship.

Title: Extend owner action audit beyond grooming
Epic: EP-10 Local event and audit spine
UserStory: As an owner, I want a trail of people-desk actions so that I can explain what changed last week.
AcceptanceCriteria: Listed action types are recorded with actor + timestamp. | Owner can view recent actions in Admin.
SuccessMetric: Support questions about “who changed Youth” answered from UI without DB queries.

Title: Ship an interactive Monday pass checklist
Epic: EP-14 Accounts, sessions, and the people desk
UserStory: As an owner, I want to check off Monday steps so that I know when I can stop.
AcceptanceCriteria: Four steps with done/pending states. | Catch-up action queues Warm Explore tasks. | Completion timestamp visible.
SuccessMetric: ≥50% of weeks show a completed Monday pass marker on Automat.

Title: Add a Secrets & connections health card
UserStory: As an owner, I want secrets health beside Plex health so that backups and keys stay paired.
AcceptanceCriteria: Card reflects MAC mismatch state. | Lists services where certified XOR key-set disagree.
SuccessMetric: Secrets incidents detected from Overview without Logs.

Title: Prefer troubleshooting bundles over impersonation
Epic: EP-14 Accounts, sessions, and the people desk
UserStory: As a maintainer helping an owner, I want a safe bundle so that I can diagnose without household chat logs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Bundle contains no raw secrets or message bodies. | Documented in HELP owner half.
SuccessMetric: Bundle used in ≥3 maintainer assists without snapshot zips.

Title: Add a household status strip for optional surfaces
UserStory: As a member, I want a glanceable stack status so that I understand empty Live without asking.
AcceptanceCriteria: Strip reflects Live ready, LLM configured, Mail enabled. | Owner can hide it.
SuccessMetric: Reduction in Live Off “is it broken?” owner pings.
